title.en: Through Every Storm, We Get Every Wire Right
title.zh: 在风浪中，把每一根线做好

highlight.en: 100% continuity testing on every wiring harness
highlight.zh: 对每条线束进行100%导通测试

zh: 疫情最艰难的几年，全球供应链仿佛一根被反复弯折的线。工厂停工、物流受阻，铜材与连接器价格持续波动。在某国，一些客户的设备已经完成装配，却可能因为缺少一个接头、一条线束，迟迟无法交付。那时，超斯迈尔的成员还分散在生产、工程、品质和外贸等不同岗位。我们见过客户因为一个不起眼的零件被迫停线，也见过有人为了赶交期而省略必要的检测。
正是这些经历，让团队逐渐形成了一个共同的认识：线束虽然藏在设备内部，却连接着机器的稳定运行、企业的商业信誉，以及最终使用者的安全与信任。
风浪逐渐平息后，团队没有急着追求规模，而是先把多年积累的经验整理成工艺标准、检验流程和交付规范。2023年，这些经验正式汇聚成超斯迈尔。创业之后，公司同样经历过订单起伏、成本波动、设备调整和生产线升级。订单繁忙时，我们守住交期与品质；市场放缓时，我们重新审视每一道工序，改进压接标准，完善物料管理，为下一次出发做好准备。
今天，我们坚持对每条线束进行100%导通测试，也愿意认真对待小批量、定制化和看似不起眼的需求。我们不依靠虚构的荣誉证明自己，因为客户的复购、完整的检测记录、可追溯的材料，以及一次次兑现的承诺，本身就是最有分量的背书。
我们相信，商业不只是完成一笔交易，更是认真对待每一次托付。诚实、守约、勤勉、责任与尊重，不应只是写在墙上的口号，而应体现在每一次报价、压接、检验和交付之中。公司或许年轻，但它所坚持的原则，来自更早的经历，也将支撑我们走向更远的地方。
en: During the most difficult years of the pandemic, the global supply chain felt like a wire being bent back and forth again and again. Factories shut down, logistics were disrupted, and the prices of copper and connectors continued to fluctuate. In one country, some customers had already finished assembling their equipment, yet delivery was delayed simply because a connector or a wiring harness was missing.

At that time, the people who would later form the Super Smile team were still working in different roles across production, engineering, quality control, and international trade. We saw customers forced to halt production because of a seemingly insignificant component, and we also saw necessary inspections skipped in the rush to meet delivery deadlines.

Those experiences gradually led us to a shared understanding: although wiring harnesses are hidden inside equipment, they connect far more than components. They support the stable operation of machines, the commercial reputation of businesses, and the safety and trust of the people who ultimately use them.

As the turbulence began to subside, the team did not rush to pursue scale. Instead, we first turned years of accumulated experience into process standards, inspection procedures, and delivery protocols. In 2023, those experiences were formally brought together under Super Smile.

Since then, the company has faced its own ups and downs, including fluctuations in orders and costs, equipment adjustments, and production-line upgrades. When orders were strong, we protected both delivery schedules and quality. When the market slowed, we re-examined every process, improved our crimping standards, strengthened material management, and prepared ourselves for the next stage of growth.

Today, we perform 100% continuity testing on every wiring harness. We also take small-batch orders, customized projects, and seemingly minor requirements seriously. We do not rely on fabricated honors to prove ourselves, because repeat orders, complete testing records, traceable materials, and promises kept time after time are the strongest endorsements of all.

We believe that business is not merely about completing a transaction; it is about honoring every trust placed in us. Honesty, keeping our word, diligence, responsibility, and respect should not be slogans written on a wall. They should be reflected in every quotation, every crimp, every inspection, and every delivery.
Our company may be young, but the principles we uphold were shaped by experiences that began long before it was founded—and they will continue to carry us forward.

text.bn: ফ্যাক্টরি ডাইরেক্ট সরবরাহ, সঠিক কানেক্টর ম্যাচিং, কম MOQ নমুনা এবং OEM প্যাকেজিং। চালানের আগে ১০০% পরিদর্শন, UL/RoHS/SVHC অনুমোদিত, স্থিতিশীল সরবরাহ।
text.pt: Fornecimento direto da fábrica, conexão precisa, amostras de baixo MOQ e embalagem OEM. Inspeção 100% antes do envio, conforme UL/RoHS/SVHC, fornecimento estável.

text.id: Pasokan langsung pabrik, pencocokan konektor presisi, sampel MOQ rendah, dan kemasan OEM. Inspeksi 100% sebelum pengiriman, sesuai UL/RoHS/SVHC, pasokan stabil.
text.de: Direktlieferung ab Werk, präzise Steckeranpassung, Muster mit niedriger MOQ und OEM-Verpackung. 100% Prüfung vor Versand, UL/RoHS/SVHC-konform, stabile Lieferung.

text.it: Fornitura diretta in fabbrica, abbinamento preciso dei connettori, campioni a basso MOQ e imballo OEM. Ispezione 100% prima della spedizione, conforme UL/RoHS/SVHC, fornitura stabile.

text.en: Send drawing/sample/connector photos → engineering review → samples in 7 working days → mass production. Clear connector photos and pinouts greatly reduce sample revision time.

text.hi: ड्राइंग/नमूना/कनेक्टर फोटो भेजें → इंजीनियरिंग समीक्षा → 7 कार्यदिवसों में नमूना → बड़े पैमाने पर उत्पादन।
text.es: Envíe plano/muestra/fotos del conector → revisión de ingeniería → muestras en 7 días → producción en serie.
text.fr: Envoyez plan/échantillon/photos de connecteur → revue technique → échantillons en 7 jours → production en série.
text.ar: أرسل الرسم/العينة/صور الموصل → المراجعة الهندسية → عينات خلال 7 أيام → الإنتاج الضخم.

text.pt: Envie desenho/amostra/fotos do conector → revisão de engenharia → amostras em 7 dias → produção em massa.
text.ru: Отправьте чертёж/образец/фото разъёма → инженерная проверка → образцы за 7 дней → серийное производство.
text.ur: ڈرائنگ/نمونہ/کنیکٹر تصاویر بھیجیں → انجینئرنگ جائزہ → 7 دن میں نمونہ → بڑے پیمانے پر پیداوار۔
text.id: Kirim gambar/sampel/foto konektor → tinjauan teknik → sampel dalam 7 hari → produksi massal.
text.de: Zeichnung/Muster/Steckerfotos senden → technische Prüfung → Muster in 7 Tagen → Serienfertigung.
text.ja: 図面・サンプル・コネクタ写真を送付 → 技術確認 → 7営業日でサンプル → 量産。
text.tr: Çizim/numune/konnektör fotoğrafı gönderin → mühendislik incelemesi → 7 günde numune → seri üretim.
text.vi: Gửi bản vẽ/mẫu/ảnh đầu nối → xem xét kỹ thuật → mẫu trong 7 ngày → sản xuất hàng loạt.
text.ko: 도면/샘플/커넥터 사진 발송 → 엔지니어링 검토 → 7일 내 샘플 → 양산.
text.it: Invia disegno/campione/foto del connettore → revisione tecnica → campioni in 7 giorni → produzione in serie.
text.nl: Stuur tekening/monster/connectorfoto's → technische beoordeling → monsters in 7 dagen → massaproductie.
text.pl: Wyślij rysunek/próbkę/zdjęcia złącza → przegląd techniczny → próbki w 7 dni → produkcja seryjna.
text.th: ส่งแบบ/ตัวอย่าง/รูปหัวต่อ → ตรวจสอบทางวิศวกรรม → ตัวอย่างใน 7 วัน → ผลิตจำนวนมาก

text.en: The Stock Center shows only selected ready-to-ship models. Other automotive, industrial, medical and new-energy harnesses can all be developed from your drawing, sample, connector photo or pinout.
text.zh: 现货中心仅展示部分常备型号。汽车、工业、医疗、新能源等其他线束，均可按图纸、样品、接口照片或针脚定义开发。
text.hi: स्टॉक केंद्र केवल चुने हुए तैयार मॉडल दिखाता है। अन्य ऑटोमोटिव, औद्योगिक, चिकित्सा और नई-ऊर्जा हार्नेस आपके ड्राइंग, नमूने, कनेक्टर फोटो या पिनआउट से बनाए जा सकते हैं।
text.es: El Centro de stock muestra solo modelos seleccionados listos para enviar. Los demás arneses para automoción, industria, medicina y nuevas energías se desarrollan a partir de planos, muestras, fotos o pinout.
text.fr: Le Centre de stock ne présente qu'une sélection de modèles prêts à expédier. Les autres faisceaux automobiles, industriels, médicaux et nouvelles énergies sont développés d'après plan, échantillon, photo ou brochage.
text.ar: يعرض مركز المخزون نماذج مختارة جاهزة للشحن فقط. ويمكن تطوير بقية ضفائر السيارات والصناعة والطب والطاقة الجديدة من الرسم أو العينة أو صورة الموصل أو مخطط الأطراف.
text.bn: স্টক সেন্টারে কেবল নির্বাচিত প্রস্তুত মডেল দেখানো হয়। অন্যান্য অটোমোটিভ, শিল্প, চিকিৎসা ও নতুন-শক্তি হারনেস ড্রয়িং, নমুনা, কানেক্টর ছবি বা পিনআউট থেকে তৈরি করা যায়।
text.pt: A Central de estoque mostra apenas modelos selecionados prontos para envio. Outros chicotes automotivos, industriais, médicos e de nova energia podem ser desenvolvidos por desenho, amostra, foto ou pinagem.
text.ru: В Центре товаров в наличии представлены только избранные готовые модели. Другие автомобильные, промышленные, медицинские и энергетические жгуты разрабатываем по чертежу, образцу, фото разъёма или распиновке.
text.ur: اسٹاک سینٹر صرف منتخب تیار ماڈلز دکھاتا ہے۔ دیگر آٹوموٹیو، صنعتی، طبی اور نئی توانائی ہارنس ڈرائنگ، نمونے، کنیکٹر تصویر یا پن آؤٹ سے تیار کیے جا سکتے ہیں۔
text.id: Pusat Stok hanya menampilkan model siap kirim pilihan. Harness otomotif, industri, medis, dan energi baru lainnya dapat dikembangkan dari gambar, sampel, foto konektor, atau pinout.
text.de: Das Lagerzentrum zeigt nur ausgewählte versandfertige Modelle. Weitere Kabelbäume für Automotive, Industrie, Medizin und neue Energien entwickeln wir nach Zeichnung, Muster, Steckerfoto oder Pinbelegung.
text.ja: 在庫センターには一部の即納モデルのみを掲載しています。自動車・産業・医療・新エネルギー向けの各種ハーネスを、図面・サンプル・コネクタ写真・ピン配列から開発できます。
text.tr: Stok Merkezi yalnızca seçili sevke hazır modelleri gösterir. Diğer otomotiv, endüstriyel, medikal ve yeni enerji kablo demetleri çizim, numune, konnektör fotoğrafı veya pin diziliminden geliştirilebilir.
text.vi: Trung tâm hàng sẵn chỉ hiển thị một số mẫu sẵn giao. Các bộ dây ô tô, công nghiệp, y tế và năng lượng mới khác đều có thể phát triển từ bản vẽ, mẫu, ảnh đầu nối hoặc sơ đồ chân.
text.ko: 재고 센터에는 일부 즉시 출하 모델만 표시됩니다. 자동차·산업·의료·신에너지용 기타 하네스도 도면, 샘플, 커넥터 사진 또는 핀 배열로 개발할 수 있습니다.
text.it: Il Centro scorte mostra solo modelli selezionati pronti alla spedizione. Gli altri cablaggi automotive, industriali, medicali e per nuove energie possono essere sviluppati da disegno, campione, foto o pinout.
text.nl: Het Voorraadcentrum toont alleen geselecteerde verzendklare modellen. Andere kabelbomen voor automotive, industrie, medische apparatuur en nieuwe energie ontwikkelen we uit tekening, monster, connectorfoto of pinbezetting.
text.pl: Centrum magazynowe pokazuje tylko wybrane modele gotowe do wysyłki. Inne wiązki samochodowe, przemysłowe, medyczne i energetyczne opracujemy na podstawie rysunku, próbki, zdjęcia złącza lub pinoutu.
text.th: ศูนย์สินค้าพร้อมส่งแสดงเฉพาะรุ่นที่คัดเลือก สายไฟสำหรับยานยนต์ อุตสาหกรรม การแพทย์ และพลังงานใหม่อื่น ๆ สามารถพัฒนาจากแบบ ตัวอย่าง รูปหัวต่อ หรือผังขาได้
